units.source_text: “听说那位叫什么国宝先生—小宫先生的，他画的江户小花纹，年轻人穿起来反而耀眼夺目。

en.t: I hear that Mr. Komiya, the one they call some kind of Living National Treasure, paints Edo komon patterns that look all the more dazzling when young people wear them.

units.source_text: 从身旁走过的人，都要回头瞧上一眼呢。”

en.t: People passing by all turn back for another look, you know.
